text: bro i drunk texted my ex at 3am saying 'i miss ur dog' and she replied 'the dog died 2 months ago' 💀 i've never recovered
i'm in a committed relationship with someone who doesn't know we're dating. it's been 4 months. we've never spoken.
my body count is 1 and it was so bad i told everyone i'm saving myself for marriage now
i catfished myself on tinder using my own pics with better lighting just to see if i'd get more matches. i did. depression hits different.
i faked an orgasm so convincingly that i won an argument about it later. method acting goes crazy.
my best friend's boyfriend keeps texting me 'wyd' at 1am and i haven't told her because she's finally happy and i'm scared
i told my mom i'm at the library. i'm at his place. the only thing i'm studying is bad decisions.
i screenshot all our conversations because i know one day you'll delete them and pretend it never happened
we made out at a party and now you act like i don't exist. cool cool cool im fine haha anyway
i have a whole finsta dedicated to posting about this one guy who smiled at me in the metro. once. in 2022.
i accidentally moaned during a massage and now i can never go back to that spa. or that city. or that country.
my ex's spotify playlist still has the songs i added and that gives me more hope than it should
i told everyone i broke up with him but he actually ghosted me after i double texted. my ego is on life support.
we sext every night but in person we can't even make eye contact. modern love is a scam.
i steal hotel towels every single time. at this point my bathroom looks like a marriott. zero regrets.
i watch my ex's stories from a fake account because blocking them was supposed to mean i moved on and i haven't
i cry in the office bathroom at least twice a week and come back like 'sorry the queue was long'
i laughed at my friend's breakup story and then went home and cried because it was exactly like mine
he said 'you're like a sister to me' and i said 'haha yeah' while my soul left my body in real time
i matched with my cousin on a dating app. we both pretended it didn't happen. family dinners hit different now.
i pretend to hate rom-coms but i watched the notebook 14 times and sobbed every single time no cap
i left a relationship because the s3x was mid and i told everyone it was 'emotional incompatibility'
my toxic trait is falling in love with anyone who gives me basic human attention for more than 5 minutes straight
i send 'lol' when i'm literally sitting in complete silence with zero emotion on my face. every. single. time.
i stalked my crush's linkedin and accidentally clicked 'connect' at 2am. professional networking my ass.
we said 'no strings attached' and now i'm out here crocheting a whole relationship in my head
i pee in the shower and i will die on this hill. it saves water and time. efficiency king.
i wore the same underwear two days in a row because laundry is emotional labor and i was going through something
i have a playlist called 'moving on' that i listen to while stalking their new partner's instagram. growth.
the last time someone said 'i love you' to me it was a scam caller and honestly it was still the highlight of my week
i keep my read receipts off so people think i'm busy but really i'm just laying in bed overthinking that one text from 2019
i slid into their dms with a fire emoji on a selfie from 47 weeks ago. there is no coming back from this.
my search history would end friendships, relationships, and possibly get me a psych evaluation
i pretend i don't care about likes but i once deleted a post because it only got 11 likes in 2 hours. 3 were mine.
i kissed my best friend at a party 'as a joke' and now i think about it every single day. the joke is on me fr.
i told my therapist everything is fine. paid ₹2000 to lie for 45 minutes. could've done that at home for free.
i still sleep with the hoodie you forgot at my place. it doesn't smell like you anymore but i pretend it does.
my uber driver asked 'going to meet someone special?' and i said 'yes' but i was going to eat butter chicken alone at 11pm
